title: backroomsentity7's Additions
description: This project adds new zombie varients, an enchanted apple (not gold), and more.
body: This project adds new zombie varients: The Radiated Zombie and the Infernal Zombie (infernal being more strong and fast than the radiated.) These zombies drop special flesh that can be used to make potions and items, This project also adds a new Dimension: the Toxic Planet, Which spawns Toxic Goo that drop reasources. This project also adds the Enchanted Apple, It gives the same effects as the enchanted golden apple but without Absorption, it is also cheap to make.
